extracted.intended_audience: Australian journalists, publishers, complainants and media organisations (participants in or subject to Australian Press Council processes)
extracted.subtask_description: A listing/page for the Australian Press Council that presents recent adjudications and points to the Council's binding standards, statement(s) of principle, advisory guidance, and complaints-handling processes used to evaluate published material.

rubrics_metrics.name: Standards of Practice
rubrics_metrics.description: The Press Council's Statement of General Principles forms part of its Standards of Practice which are binding on all print and online publishers that are members.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Adjudications published on this page consider whether published material breached the Standards of Practice; see 'Specific Standards' and 'Advisory Guidelines' for further detail. No scoring rubric is provided on this page; the Standards are described elsewhere on the site.

rubrics_metrics.name: Statements of Principles
rubrics_metrics.description: The Council's Statements of Principles are binding on all publications which are subject to its jurisdiction.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Statements of Principles set out the core obligations for member publications; the page repeatedly refers to adjudications that test whether these principles were breached.

rubrics_metrics.name: Specific Standards
rubrics_metrics.description: Specific Standards — the Press Council's Statement of General Principles forms part of its Standards of Practice which are binding on all print and online publishers that are members.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed separately in the site navigation as a place to find more detailed, topic-specific standards that supplement the general principles.

rubrics_metrics.name: Advisory Guidelines
rubrics_metrics.description: Advisory Guidelines — the Press Council's Statement of General Principles forms part of its Standards of Practice which are binding on all print and online publishers that are members.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Advisory Guidelines provide interpretive or practical guidance to publishers about meeting the Standards and Principles; they are presented as supplementary material to the Standards of Practice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Council responsibilities / evaluative aims
rubrics_metrics.description: The council is responsible for promoting high standards of media practice, community access to information of public interest, and freedom of expression through the media.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These stated aims frame how the Council evaluates complaints and adjudicates disputes between complainants and publishers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Complaint eligibility and information
rubrics_metrics.description: Information for complainants: what can be complained about; who can complain; how to make a complaint.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The site provides a section to explain eligibility and procedure for complainants; it also states 'The fastest way is using our online complaints form here.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Handling of complaints (process standards)
rubrics_metrics.description: Handling of complaints — Council processes for investigation, mediation and adjudication.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This encompasses the procedural standards the Council follows (investigation, mediation, adjudication) when determining whether a publication breached the Standards of Practice; the adjudication listings are outputs of that process.

rubrics_metrics.name: Adjudication criterion: breach of Standards of Practice
rubrics_metrics.description: Adjudications consider whether its Standards of Practice were breached by a specific published item (article, cartoon, video, homepage item, etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each listed adjudication summarises the complaint (who complained and the item complained about) and notes that the Press Council considered whether the Standards of Practice were breached; the page acts as a public record of those determinations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publications and formats subject to review
rubrics_metrics.description: Print, online and social media content published by member publications (articles, front-page headlines, cartoons, videos, homepage items) are subject to the Council's jurisdiction and adjudication.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Adjudication examples on the page show the range of formats reviewed. The Standards of Practice and Statements of Principles apply across these formats for member publications.
